aprotinin_hazard_scale.source: FIXTURE:synthetic-literature - stands for a paper reporting an antifibrinolytic hazard ratio. No such extraction exists.
aprotinin_hazard_scale.quote: FIXTURE - placeholder for the sentence a real extraction would carry.

unmodelled_mentions: Serum in the medium carries plasminogen, so lysis timing depends on the feed schedule - the twin has no term for medium composition.
Suture anchoring over the PDMS pins occasionally slips, which is neither a casting failure nor contamination and is not in the attrition model.
Gel thickness varies with pipetting and changes the surface-to-volume ratio that lysis proceeds from; the twin treats every construct as identical.
